final: WITH f AS (SELECT orderslink, rebtotal, rebrate / NULLIF(feerate, 0) AS ratio FROM fees WHERE rebrate >= 0.0005 AND orderslink IS NOT NULL), per AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM f GROUP BY orderslink), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM per) SELECT p.orderslink, p.avg_rebtotal, p.avg_ratio, CASE WHEN m.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL THEN p.avg_ratio / m.mean_ratio END AS rel_ratio FROM per p CROSS JOIN m ORDER BY (rel_ratio IS NULL), rel_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
